prompts.name: sports-club
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: in-page collection cover for FACT//DUEL web product, image only.
Primary request: premium editorial 3D still life of a cobalt blue cricket ball with a clear stitched seam, an off-white football (association football/soccer ball), a small tangerine orange basketball, and one sculptural abstract trophy arranged on matte midnight navy plinths.
Scene/backdrop: seamless dark midnight navy studio gallery setting with navy floor, polished collectible objects.
Style/medium: intentional premium editorial 3D product art with tactile realistic materials, crisp clean silhouettes and edges, sophisticated sculptural gallery collectibles.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2. All main objects and plinths concentrated in the RIGHT HALF of the image. Entire left half is uncluttered dark navy negative space suitable for overlay collection text, no text actually rendered. Balanced camera view, full objects visible.
Lighting/mood: punchy directional studio light, crisp highlights, controlled soft shadows.
Color palette: strong cobalt, offwhite, tangerine accents, deep midnight navy background.
Constraints: NO text, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO real people. Not a UI screenshot. Avoid neon cyberpunk and avoid luminous busy background. Generate one image only.
